name: Khanate
description: '''Khanate''' is an American [[drone doom]] [[Supergroup (music)|supergroup]] consisting of [[James Plotkin]] and [[Alan Dubin]] ([[OLD (band)|OLD]]), as well as [[Tim Wyskida]] ([[Blind Idiot God]], Manbyrd) and [[Stephen O'Malley]] ([[Burning Witch]], [[Sunn O)))]]). Keeping some similarity with O'Malley's previous band Burning Witch, Khanate produces songs that usually exceeded the 10-minute mark, characterized by extremely slow [[tempo]]s, harsh layers of [[feedback]], and vocalist Alan Dubin's shrieking.
